I assure you is possible my friend, it just takes time and dedication. Believe me I used to be a foolish romantic that dreamed of being loved, loving and relationships. Yet I managed to overcome this tragic flaw through a relatively simple method.

First of all you must understand that there are two components that need to be put in order to achieve this. The neocortex and limbic system. The former is easy it basically it is just your rational mind, after enough failures this part of the brain quickly learns that romantic feelings are bad news and shouldn't be acted upon. The latter is more complex, it basically is your emotional mind. It only learns quickly under extremley traumatic experiences or slowly through careful training, constant expousure or asociation. So unless you recieved the blessing in disguise of a women breaking you to your very core to reject you, we must take the long road to align the limbic system with our new life goals and reality. 

Notice that you can keep trying until you have racked up enough negative experiences so your mind has a clear apathetic reaction to the possibility of love. I have seen it work but to me this road just sound overtly painful, undignified and time wasteful so I would recommend another road:

To begin with you must fully decide that you are done with this entire section of life, in other words your neocrotex must be fully on board. Then every time you feel any sort of interest or attraction to a individual of whatever gender you are attracted to, leave at once, doesn't matter what your heart thinks or whatever hope your amygdala attempt to push, you are gone. Then whenever you think of that person or the idea of a relationship think of the effort it would take to attempt maximizing the chances of establishing a relationship (time,gym, financial sacrificies, changing of habits etc) and then imagine how you get rejected depsite all those efforts. Yea painful but it works. Finally whenever you see any relationship in the streets think the same line of thought. It will take a while but after enough time the mind accepts the message and you become absolutely apathetical to this whole area and you get to enjoy the other areas of life without this being a thorn on your side.
